data.one_liner: Flutter widget that animates a smooth transition between two SVG assets.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedSvg widget controlled by an SvgController. It cross‑fades or morphs between two SVGs over a configurable duration.
use_when: You need animated icons or buttons that switch between SVG states
You want a simple, declarative way to animate SVG transitions without writing custom animation code
avoid_when: Complex vector animations requiring path morphing beyond simple cross‑fade
Performance‑critical scenes where a full‑featured animation engine is required
strengths: Very easy to integrate – just add the widget and controller
Works on all Flutter platforms supported by flutter_svg
weaknesses: Limited to transitioning between two static SVGs
Relies on flutter_svg, so any limitations of that package apply

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides basic SVG rendering without animation, useful if you only need static SVGs

alternatives.name: vector_graphics
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a compiled SVG format with potentially better performance for static graphics
